name: Sunray Oasis 300SC | 2-4-Person Traditional Canopy Barrel Sauna
description: Description The SunRay Oasis 2–4 Person Barrel Sauna features a unique canopy design with covered roof and exterior benches on each side of the door. The benches can be used for seating before your session or as a cool-down area between sauna cycles. Measuring 6' deep by 6' wide, the Oasis is sized for backyard relaxation and social use. Equipped with a 6.0 kW Harvia electric heater, it reaches 170–180°F and includes a built-in delay timer allowing you to set the start time up to 8 hours in advance. The sauna includes a flat floor kit, shingled roof for outdoor durability, and solid red cedar ball-and-socket construction with stainless steel hardware for long-lasting strength. Standard features include dome interior lighting that turns off automatically with the heater, ergonomic backrests, tempered glass, and a complete accessory kit with bucket, ladle, thermo-hygrometer, sand timer, and heater stones. Designed for indoor or outdoor use, the Oasis provides a versatile and durable wellness solution.
